title: LinkedIn Tools
viewer: Hiring manager or general portfolio viewer
takeaway: LinkedIn Tools keeps risky browser automation behind review gates and leaves a record of every run.

scenes.intent: Browser automation is easy to demo. It is harder to trust.
scenes.headline: Browser automation is easy to demo.

scenes.intent: The question was ownership. Which workflow can act, and what record remains?
scenes.headline: Trust depends on clear ownership.

scenes.intent: LinkedIn Tools adds review before action. The workflow must be approved first.
scenes.headline: Review happens before action.
scenes.assetAlt: Public isolated LinkedIn Tools review interface.

scenes.intent: Each workflow has a clear limit. Some can send, some only suggest.
scenes.headline: Every workflow has a clear limit.

scenes.intent: Runs leave records behind. The system can explain what happened.
scenes.headline: Every run leaves inspectable records.
scenes.assetAlt: LinkedIn Tools review UI used as evidence of inspectable workflow state.

scenes.intent: Automation with review and records. Every run leaves proof.
scenes.headline: Automation with review and records.

hide: private LinkedIn messages, profile names, photos, contact lists, and handles
browser profiles, cookies, credentials, sessions, and tokens
live account state, local state paths, real drafts, and send queues
safe: public project name and workflow labels
synthetic guardrail, lane, and evidence graphics
